title: Southern Pride 3oz Loose Leaf Chewing Tobacco
description:
Southern Pride 3oz Loose Leaf Chewing Tobacco

Southern Pride 3oz Loose Leaf Chewing Tobacco is a classic loose leaf-style chewing product. Loose leaf chewing tobacco is the most common type of chewing tobacco. It simply consists of shredded tobacco leaves. Southern Pride 3ozs Loose Leaf has a traditional tobacco flavor and is manufacture by The Pinkerton Tobacco Company. The nicotine strength is 2 on a 5-grade scale, placing it within the “normal” range compared to similar chewing tobacco products. Chewing tobacco can also be experienced in plug and long cut. You can find more classic chewing tobacco on the Southern Pride brand page.
